_source: Duration, cooldown and effects belgeler/wiki/ships.md (darkorbitwiki). Menu items from the client's shortcut menu (MenuInitializationCommand in the recording, 'ship_abilities' category, 65 items). Visuals from the client's code: AbilityEffectActivationCommand.selectedAbilityId = the client's skill code (EventAssemblySkills: 1 Solace, 2 Diminisher, 3 Spectrum, 4 Sentinel, 5 Venom, 6 speed effect 'speed-buff-effect'), AbilityStartCommand: 102 Draw Fire, 106 Target Marker (MarkedByRecon), 110 EMP visual, 111 minimap (AddDoubleMinimapRevealEffect), 101 Aegis HP Repair and 104 Shield Repair (for these ids the client plays abilitySounds 90 aegisHPRepair and 91 aegisShieldRecharge; belgeler/istemci/gorseller.md). Repair Pod places a HEALING_POD (AssetType 33) object on the map ('entity'; live test 2026-10-17). Fortify and Protection ship appearance ('appearance': the client's VisualModifier, VisualModifierCommand; 8 FORTIFY armor, 9 PROTECT_OWNER red ring; live test 2026-10-17). The visual of Ultimate Cloak is not settled.
_effects: hp_percent: ratio of max hp, instantly; hp_repair / shield_repair: total over the duration (equal per second); mods: profile bonuses over the duration (speed, laser, damage_taken, laser_taken, shield_damage_taken; fixed_speed: the displayed speed is set to this value, 0 = does not move); target_shield_damage: damage multiplier to the target's shield over the duration (1.5 = the shield melts 1.5 times the share it absorbs, hull share unchanged; Weaken Shields), shield_loss: when the effect ends, this ratio of the player's OWN shield is lost (Weaken Shields); mirror: this ratio of the damage taken (raw damage before reduction) returns to the attacker, together with mods.damage_taken (Revenge); teleport_to_target: teleport to the target's position (Sleight; no range limit, the target slows down via target_slow); poison: one hit per second on the target's hull (first, increase, max_count, total); target_damage: damage bonus on the marked target; draw_fire: aliens in range attack; cloak: aliens cannot see (ends on attacking, collecting a box, jumping); vision: view distance multiplier; rocket_cooldown_ms: rocket cooldown. E5: target_shield_off: this ratio of the target's shield is switched off over the duration, restored when it ends (Shield Disarray); target_fire_interval: the target's laser cooldown [min, max] s (DDoL); cargo {source: kills | chain, maximum, range (laser range per charge when not active), mods (per spent charge), ramp (each charge adds this much more than the previous one), max_speed}: an ability that accumulates charges, cannot be pressed without charges, charges are spent when it becomes active (Momentum, Stockpile, Volt Discharge); reverse: negative attributes of equipped modules become positive, if there are no negatives these bonuses (Self Reversal); reload {per_second, maximum, split_radius}: a hit that fills up on the target, when full / when time ends / when the target leaves range (Charge Shot); shield_melt: the shield melts by this ratio of the max shield per second, close_at_zero: the ability ends at 0 (Scramble, Supercharge Plus); triangle_blast {damage, radius, distance}: three explosions in a triangle behind the target (Triple Barrage); next_gsp: once, on the next Singularity Drive shot (Quantum Amplifier); reflect_laser: the damage reduced by laser_taken returns to the attacker (Prismatic Reflecting); undying: when hp is left at 1, invulnerable for this many s and the ability ends (Volt Back-up); launcher_damage, top, cannon_cooldown: mods keys (launcher damage, Particle Cannon damage and cooldown).

ability_diminisher.name: Weaken Shields
ability_diminisher._note: client: damage to the enemy's shield +50% (the shield melts 1.5 times the share it absorbs, the share passing to the hull is the same); when the effect ends 30% of the player's OWN shield is lost

ability_citadel_protection.name: Protection
ability_citadel_protection._note: takes over the group members' damage; no effect in single-player (with bot players)

ability_spearhead_jam-x.name: JAM-X
ability_spearhead_jam-x._note: stops enemy ship abilities; aliens have no abilities (with bot players)

ability_spearhead_target-marker.name: Target Marker
ability_spearhead_target-marker._note: damage percentage is not in the wiki (adaptation 5%)

ability_tartarus_rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire
ability_tartarus_rapid-fire._note: cooldown from the client's ship data (Tartarus 24 s, Tartarus Plus 72 s); that the normal rocket cooldown also drops to 1 s is unverified (client: the launcher's "one second instead of three")

ability_basilisk_noxious-nebula.name: Noxious Nebula
ability_basilisk_noxious-nebula._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_basilisk_heightened-valour.name: Heightened Valour
ability_basilisk_heightened-valour._note: no group and no stored charge

ability_berserker_shl.name: Shield Link
ability_berserker_shl._note: takes over the group member's shield damage: with bot players

ability_berserker_bsk.name: Berserk
ability_berserker_bsk._note: each 1% hp lost gives +1% laser damage

ability_berserker_rvg.name: Revenge
ability_berserker_rvg._note: client: 100% of the damage taken goes directly back to the attacker, the player takes only 5% of the damage, the ship slows down; the reflected amount is the raw damage before reduction

ability_disruptor_redirect.name: Redirect
ability_disruptor_redirect._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_disruptor_shield-disarray.name: Shield Disarray
ability_disruptor_shield-disarray._note: client: 50% of the target's shield is switched off over the duration, the switched-off amount is added back when it ends

ability_disruptor_ddol.name: DDoL
ability_disruptor_ddol._note: client: the target's laser cooldown is random between 3-5 s over the duration (the text does not limit it to players: aliens too; unverified)

ability_hammerclaw-plus_reallocate.name: Reallocate
ability_hammerclaw-plus_reallocate._note: client/wiki: over the duration, 20% of the damage dealt by GROUP MEMBERS is distributed at the end as equal HP to group members within 700 units; a solo player has no group: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_hecate_particle-beam.name: Particle Beam
ability_hecate_particle-beam._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_hecate-plus_particle-beam-plus.name: Particle Beam Plus
ability_hecate-plus_particle-beam-plus._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_hecate-plus_stockpile.name: Stockpile
ability_hecate-plus_stockpile._note: client: an alien kill is one charge (max 10); while inactive, +5 range per charge; on activation, shield +0.2%, each charge 0.2% more than the previous (+11% at 10 charges); charges reset

ability_holo_self-reversal.name: Self Reversal
ability_holo_self-reversal._note: client: the negative attributes of equipped modules turn positive for the duration; if there are no negatives, a damage and speed bonus (wiki +10%/+10%)

ability_holo_enemy-reversal.name: Enemy Reversal
ability_holo_enemy-reversal._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_hyperion_ga.name: Gravitational Anchor
ability_hyperion_ga._note: client: the area is at the target's position, those inside are 80% slower; radius is an adaptation (600)

ability_hyperion_qa.name: Quantum Amplifier
ability_hyperion_qa._note: client: Singularity Drive attack damage +10% (duration 0: until the next shot; unverified)

ability_keres_spr.name: Spread
ability_keres_spr._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_keres_sle.name: Sleight
ability_keres_sle._note: client: teleport to the targeted ship, then the target's speed drops 60% for the duration (the text does not restrict it to players: aliens too; difference from Spread); having the target selected is enough (no range limit)

ability_mimesis_scramble.name: Scramble
ability_mimesis_scramble._note: client: the shield melts away over the duration, shuts off at 0; 10% of max shield per second (wiki)

ability_mimesis_phase-out.name: Phase Out
ability_mimesis_phase-out._note: client: teleports 50 units in a random direction (except pirate map, Galaxy Gate, CSZ, UBA); VisualModifier PHASE_OUT (4) fades the ship for the duration, at the end an instant MoveCommand places the ship at its new position (live K6)

ability_orcus_assimilate.name: Assimilate
ability_orcus_assimilate._note: 80% of alien damage is returned as HP

ability_paladin_last-stand.name: Last Stand
ability_paladin_last-stand._note: HP is restored on a lethal hit

ability_retiarus_chs.name: Charge Shot
ability_retiarus_chs._note: client: accumulates charge on the target in range, strikes with the accumulated charge when full or when the target leaves range; charges over a duration of 300,000 (wiki)

ability_retiarus-plus_chsp.name: Super Charge Shot
ability_retiarus-plus_chsp._note: client: strikes when charging finishes; wiki: +45,000 per second, max 450,000, split among those within 200 of the target, speed -10% while charging

ability_retiarus-plus_spcp.name: Supercharge Plus
ability_retiarus-plus_spcp._note: client: speed, the Particle Cannon cooldown shortens and its damage increases, shield loss per second (wiki: cooldown -50%, damage +10%, shield -10%/s)

ability_spearhead-plus_jamx-creed.name: JAMX Creed
ability_spearhead-plus_jamx-creed._note: affects only players: with bot players (Phase 11)

ability_spearhead-plus_neutralizing-mark.name: Neutralizing Marker
ability_spearhead-plus_neutralizing-mark._note: client: marks the target (laser damage increases; wiki +4%), own speed +5%; the target's shield penetration -50% (PvP)

ability_spectrum-plus_prismatic-reflecti.name: Prismatic Reflecting
ability_spectrum-plus_prismatic-reflecti._note: client: incoming laser damage -70%, the reduced portion returns to the attacker; own laser -50%

ability_tartarus-plus_rapid-fire-plus.name: Rapid Fire Plus
ability_tartarus-plus_rapid-fire-plus._note: client: fills the launcher, launcher damage +20% (launcher only)

ability_tempest_volt-discharge.name: Volt Discharge
ability_tempest_volt-discharge._note: client: each jump of Voltage Link is one charge (max 20), all are spent on activation; laser +0.75% per charge (wiki)

ability_tempest_volt-backup.name: Volt Back-up
ability_tempest_volt-backup._note: client: for the duration HP does not drop below 1, then 3 s of invulnerability and the ability goes on cooldown

ability_zephyr_mmt.name: Momentum
ability_zephyr_mmt._note: client: an alien kill is one charge (max 20); while inactive, +5 range per charge; on activation, +1.5% speed per charge (max 750), charges reset

ability_zephyr_tbr.name: Triple Barrage
ability_zephyr_tbr._note: client: three triangular explosions behind the target, 20,000 each; overlapping areas add up. Radius 200 (official Turkish forum 158403 Winter FAQ); interval is an adaptation (150)

_ships: Ship -> abilities; Elite/Veteran designs use the main ship's abilities, multipliers are the design bonuses from the wiki (duration, cooldown, effect). Defcom/Raven Ultimate Cloaking, Yamato/Ronin Travel (wiki): no items of their own in the client, Spearhead's and Citadel's items are used. A-Elite has no repair multiplier: the client's short durations (Shield Repair 4 s, HP Repair 6 s) with the same total already give "20%/10% faster" (E5).
_private: ship -> ability -> duration_sec/cooldown_sec: from the client's ship data (tools/ship_abilities.py); effect multipliers ("multipliers") remain from the wiki, duration and cooldown from special.
